newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Jan-Aug oil output falls 2.2 pct, gas up.
newsitem.headline: Russian Jan-Aug oil output falls 2.2 pct, gas up.

text.p: Russian output of crude oil and gas condensate in January-August slipped 2.2 percent on year-ago levels to 200.9 million tonnes, State Statistics Committee figures showed on Friday.
The figures, quoted by Interfax news agency, put August output at 25.4 million tonnes but gave no comparisons.
Natural gas output in the first eight months of the year rose 0.9 percent on year-ago levels to 379.1 billion cubic metres, with August production at 40.1 billion cubic metres.
About 115.6 million tonnes of crude were refined in January-August, a fall of 5.2 percent year-on-year, with 13.8 million tonnes in August alone. No other comparative figures were provided.
